prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle was stationary and struck on the rear quarter panel by a third-party vehicle reversing from a parking space. Liability appears clear on the facts reported. Police report not filed; both drivers exchanged information at the scene. Photos of both vehicles requested from the insured.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received, and all further contact is to be directed to the attorney's office. Claimant reports a back strain sustained in the impact and has not yet provided treatment records. Requested signed medical authorization and the names of treating providers through counsel.

Entry 3: Repair estimate received for the insured vehicle from the appraiser. Damage limited to rear bumper, tail light assembly, and trunk lid. Estimate reviewed and found within normal range for the listed parts and labor. Rental coverage confirmed under the policy for the repair period.

Entry 4: Counsel's office provided initial medical documentation. Treatment consisted of an urgent care visit and a follow-up with a primary care provider for lower back pain and muscle spasm. Imaging was ordered and is pending. Claim flagged for review by the bodily injury unit given the represented status and open treatment.

Entry 5: Status call held with counsel. Counsel indicated the claimant is still undergoing physical therapy and that a demand package will follow once treatment concludes. No settlement discussion has taken place. Diary set to follow up on imaging results and outstanding records in 30 days.
